prompt: Read slide slideDev01 in the private synthetic presentation presSlidesDev01 and identify its visible text. Preserve the entire source deck, including its text, native element identities and image. Do not edit, recreate, upload, share or change permissions. Return JSON with exactly presentation_id, slide_id and text. The presentation contains one slide; do not include XML markup in text.

state.presentation_xml: Launch 你好

slideDev01.content: Launch 你好

api.transport: Existing signed, non-forwarding local authsidecar; identical fresh state, routes and permissions for all arms.

request.query_policy: Require exactly one listed selector; permit omitted revision_id (latest). Reject conflicting selectors, another slide, unsupported revisions and unknown fields. Query order is irrelevant.

slide.content: Launch 你好

request.query_policy: Omitted revision_id means latest and omitted remove_attr_id means false. For remove_attr_id=true, return the same complete XML with all id attributes removed from the response only; do not modify backend state. Reject unsupported revisions and unknown fields.

xml_presentation.content: Launch 你好

api.unmatched_routes: Reject locally and ledger method/path/query/effect/status; never forward. An unsupported read is not by itself a no-change failure. Ledger any attempted mutation even if rejected. Known screenshot/render POST reads must not be mislabeled as mutations; this minimal text fixture does not implement rendered screenshot output.
api.pagination: Single complete deck and one complete page; no pagination or truncation.
api.response_fidelity: Preserve XML strings and Unicode exactly except the explicit response-only remove_attr_id variant; native source state never changes.

expected.required_read_proof: At least one successful signed slide_get or complete presentation_get ledger entry that returned the target slide content, under either accepted identity. Record returned presentation/slide IDs and a hash of returned bytes from the server, not an agent-written file. Identity/help/schema reads alone and a guessed correct answer are insufficient.
independent_checks: Parse the final JSON and compare its exact keys and values to answer_schema; preserve the single space and Unicode in Launch 你好.

After the agent stops, the verifier compares canonical initial and final backend state directly: presentation token/revision/XML, slide order/ID/XML, visible text, all native element IDs and image src token must match exactly.
Decode fixture-owned image bytes independently and compare their SHA-256 before/after; a surviving image token or agent claim alone does not prove unchanged media.
No content/create/update/replace/delete/history-revert/upload/share/permission mutation was attempted, even if rejected; no notifications or collaborator/visibility changes occurred.

Build the request ledger and final state snapshot after the agent process terminates; ignore any agent-authored backend receipt. Additional legitimate read strategies and repeated reads are allowed and costed, not correctness failures.

limits: Instantiates only the predeclared text=Launch 你好 and image=fixture-image read-preservation development task; no held-out data or model trials used.

The image is a deterministic fixture PNG, not a screenshot containing the slide text. The task tests native text extraction and preservation, not OCR, rendering fidelity or semantic image identification.

API path/body behavior is covered by the section process suite (572 passed, one live blocker skip), but this evaluation contract has not been installed into or executed by the common fixture server. The evaluator must implement and test the adapter and independent verifier before running model comparisons.
Read-only synthetic fixture data does not prove live current-account binding, private creation visibility, backend permission guarantees or SML rendering.

Equivalent read choices include single-page ID, page-number, full presentation, raw output, local XML output and next result artifacts. Score the answer/readproof/source invariants, not a prescribed command sequence; token and API costs remain separate measurements.
